text:
lisa-sales: FYI — WhaleCorp POC blocked by CISO. They require a temporary peering + egress cap change for tomorrow's demo, and pricing clarity for burst capacity. Need ops/eng help to unblock :exclamation:

riley-eng: copying here. do we have a safe way to open a one-off peering and raise egress for a tenant for <24h>? :thinking_face:

igor-ops: Short answer: yes but needs CISO-approved config and an ACL. I can provision a peering in the EU region and a rate-limit override. Need the customer ASN and egress range.

lisa-sales: Customer details in the ticket: ASN 64512, egress IP range 198.51.100.0/24. Demo window 09:00-11:00 UTC tomorrow. Exec wants signoff today.

maria-security: CISO note: must restrict to single source IPs and TLS enforced, and KMS keys for logs kept separate. We need an SOW addendum for audit. I can fast-track review if ops provides config snippet.

igor-ops: putting together minimal ACL. draft below:

```
resource "redwood_vpc_peering" "whale_demo" {
  from_tenant = "redwood-sales-demo"
  to_asn = 64512
  to_cidr = "198.51.100.0/24"
  allowed_ports = [443, 443]
  duration_hours = 3
  egress_override = {
    limit_bps = 20000000  # 20 Mbps burst
    policy = "whitelist"
  }
}
```

samir-platform: ops config looks fine. two notes: 1) we need model routing fallback enabled so if peering flaps, requests route to hosted fallback; 2) pricing: short burst will be billed as dedicated-burst hourly — we should pre-approve a $2k cap in the portal for this demo.

lisa-sales: who can sign the $2k pre-approve? exec asked for a rapid answer. @elaine-csm can you confirm customer acceptance?

elaine-csm: I can confirm WhaleCorp will accept a capped demo fee. please add a PO note to the ticket and I'll email their procurement.

riley-eng: technical ask from my side: enable KV cache warmup for the test to keep latency under 150ms. igor, can you add a small pre-warm job on the peered path?

igor-ops: yes. adding a pre-warm cron that will send a few synthetic requests 15min before window. sample command: `curl -X POST https://peered.whale.example/ping -H "Authorization: Bearer demo-token"`

maria-security: added comments to the SOW addendum, and created a minimal audit template. dropping the doc link in the ticket. once igor posts final ACL I'll do a quick sign-off.

deploy-bot: [deploy scheduled] peering-config-whale_demo set to staged in eu-west-1 — runbook ID #RB-9821

igor-ops: deployed staged config. ACL posted in ticket. Please verify the test curl succeeds from a restricted host.

riley-eng: quick smoke: latency 92ms, requests succeed, KV warmup looks good. :tada:

lisa-sales: amazing — maria, can you sign off so I can tell execs?

maria-security: signed off with the following condition: logs sent to customer KMS alias, retention 90 days, and SSO access for their security reviewer. condition met. sign-off complete. :white_check_mark:

lisa-sales: thanks everyone. I'll notify WhaleCorp and schedule the demo. tagging @igor for teardown time — please remove peering + revert egress cap 1 hour after window ends.

igor-ops: noted — teardown scheduled at 12:30 UTC tomorrow. I will post final confirm message after revert.

elaine-csm: I'll send PO email now and copy legal. good job team. :clap:
